data.description:
## Summary
Build the **telemetry framework**: a versioned, consent-gated, pluggable pipeline that is a strict no-op unless enabled. It must work identically in dev and production and be safe/privacy-preserving.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1: A `TelemetryRecorder` interface with versioned record schemas (run header with seed/schema version/build; per-tick state+input; discrete events).
- AC2: Pluggable sinks behind one interface: a local JSONL dev sink and a remote/production sink stub; a no-op sink used when disabled.
- AC3: **Disabled by default**; explicitly enabled via config/env. A consent flag gates production recording.
- AC4: Bounded overhead/backpressure (ring buffer + batched flush) so recording never stalls gameplay; a documented sampling option.
- AC5: No PII in the schema; secrets/tokens excluded; documented data policy.
- AC6: Unit tests: no-op sink records nothing; JSONL sink round-trips; batching/flush; schema version present.
- AC7: Docs: schema reference + how to enable/disable.
data.title: Telemetry framework: versioned schema, pluggable sinks, consent flag

data.description:
Discovered while implementing AH-0MUY08VJ9006BHJO (discovered-from:AH-0MUY08VJ9006BHJO).

## Problem
`npm run build` fails inside any `.worklog/worktrees/wl-*` worktree because `scripts/build-audio.mjs` cannot find the sibling ToneForge CLI, so the copied `node_modules/toneforge/bin/dev-cli.js` tries to `import 'tsx'` and Node cannot resolve it (ToneForge's `tsx` devDependency is only installed in the sibling `../ToneForge/node_modules`).

Error:
```
Error: tf generate failed for aihell-arc-fire seed 32217:
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package 'tsx' imported from .../node_modules/toneforge/bin/dev-cli.js
```

## Root cause
`resolveToneForge()` in `scripts/build-audio.mjs` looks for the sibling at `join(repoRoot, '..', 'ToneForge', 'bin', 'dev-cli.js')`. In a worktree, `repoRoot` is the worktree directory (nested under `<main>/.worklog/worktrees/`), so `repoRoot/..` is not the main checkout's parent. It falls through to `command -v tf`, which finds the worktree's symlinked `node_modules/.bin/tf` (the copy without resolvable `tsx`). In the main checkout the sibling is found and the build passes.

## Impact
Blocks `implement.py finish` (build gate) for **every** epic child (AH-0MUY089KR003F8S4) and any future worktree-based implementation that runs `npm run build`.

## Workaround (unblocks now, no code change)
```sh
TONEFORGE_CLI=/home/rgardler/projects/ToneForge/bin/dev-cli.js npm run build
```
`resolveToneForge()` honours `TONEFORGE_CLI`, and the sibling CLI resolves its own `tsx`.

## Suggested fix
When `repoRoot/../ToneForge` is absent, resolve the main checkout from git (e.g. `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` -> parent) and probe `<main>/../ToneForge/bin/dev-cli.js` before falling back to `command -v tf`. Add a hermetic test for worktree-style `repoRoot` resolution.
data.title: Worktree builds fail: build-audio cannot resolve the sibling ToneForge CLI
